title: Quentin Tarantino Plans to Retire After His Next Movie. Christopher Nolan Hopes He ‘Won’t Stay True’ to His Word
content:
ByZack Sharf

Digital News Director

IfQuentin Tarantinoremains committed to retiring from filmmaking after his 10th feature film, then whatever movie the Oscar winner decides to make next will be his swan song from the big screen.Christopher Nolanis disappointed.

“I think it’s dangerous to look at it that specifically,” Nolan recently toldThe Telegraphabout Tarantino’s long-discussed 10-movie retirement plan. “I mean, Quentin has his reasons, and I respect those enormously. But I’m hoping that he won’t stay true to them… I view every film that I do as the last I’ll ever make, and one day I will be right. So every time I want to put everything into the project at hand. I’m never thinking, ‘Well, I’ll save this for the next one.’ I don’t ever want to think like that. I want each movie to be everything.”

Tarantino has spoken for years about his plan to retire after making 10 feature films (the “Kill Bill” movies count as one film in his eyes, as they were developed and shot as a single feature), saying he wants to leave behind a consistently strong and tightly curated body of work.

“And do you believe him?” Nolan asked the“ReelBlend” podcasthosts in 2023 while promoting “Oppenheimer.”

“Quentin’s point has always been that — and he never, very graciously, he’s never specific about the films he’s talking about or whatever — but he’s looking at some of the work done by filmmakers in later years and feeling that if it can’t live up to the heyday, it would be better if it didn’t exist,” Nolan explained at the time. “And I think that’s a very purist point of view. It’s the point of view of a cinephile who prizes film history.”

“I’m not sure that I would trust my own sense of the absolute value of a piece of work to know whether or not it should have been brought into existence,” Nolan added. “I’m a big fan, as is Quentin, of films that maybe don’t fully achieve what they try to, but there’s something in there that’s a performance, or a little structural thing, or a scene, you know, that’s wonderful. And so, yes, I understand. I think he wanted to keep a sort of perfect reputation of something, but also kind of don’t want to take anything off the table.”

Nolan and Tarantino’s friend and fellow filmmakerPaul Thomas Andersonhas been a lot more blunt in his criticism of Tarantino’s 10-movie plan.

“I know Quentin [Tarantino] likes to say, ‘I’m making 10 movies and then I’m quitting.’ But I could never do that,” Andersonsaid back in 2018. “I don’t know how he could say that, or how he could take himself seriously when he says that. This is what I want to do as long as I’m able to do it. As long as I’m able to do it, I’m going to do it. I think things can become peculiar when directors don’t act their age maybe, or seeing them try to keep up with the kids or trying to be hip. That’s never a good look.”

As for what Tarantino has planned for his 10th and alleged final feature remains to be seen. There was a time when “The Movie Critic” was being prepped as his swan song, but Tarantino has since scrapped that screenplay. Even if Tarantino does retire, there are other artistic mediums through which he can continue to put out new content. He’s already authored a few books, and his new play, “The Popinjay Cavalier,” is set to open on London’s West End in 2027.
title_zh: 昆汀·塔倫蒂諾(Quentin Tarantino)計劃在他的下一部電影後退休。克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)希望他「不會堅持自己的話」。
content_zh:
作者：扎克·沙夫(Zack Sharf)  
數位新聞總監  

如果昆汀·塔倫蒂諾(Quentin Tarantino)堅持在他的第十部長片後退休，那麼無論這位奧斯卡獲獎者決定製作什麼電影，都將是他在大銀幕上的告別之作。克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)感到失望。

“我認為這樣具體地看待是危險的，”諾蘭最近在接受《電訊報》(The Telegraph)訪問時談到塔倫蒂諾長期討論的十部電影退休計劃。“我的意思是，昆汀有他的理由，我非常尊重這些理由。但我希望他不會堅持這些……我把我所做的每一部電影都視為我將製作的最後一部，總有一天我會是對的。因此每次我都想把所有精力投入到當前的項目中。我從不想著，‘好吧，我留著這個給下一部。’我從不想這樣。我希望每部電影都能做到最好。”

塔倫蒂諾多年來一直談論他在製作十部長片後退休的計劃（在他眼中，“殺死比爾”(Kill Bill)系列算作一部電影，因為它們是作為一部完整的作品開發和拍攝的），他表示希望留下持續強大且精心策劃的作品集。

“你相信他嗎？”諾蘭在2023年為《奧本海默》(Oppenheimer)宣傳時問“ReelBlend”播客的主持人。

“昆汀的觀點一直是這樣——他從不具體談論他所說的電影或其他的，但他在看一些導演在晚年所做的作品時，感到如果這些作品無法達到巔峰，那麼它們的存在會更好，”諾蘭當時解釋道。“我認為這是一種非常純粹的觀點。這是電影愛好者對電影歷史的珍視。”

“我不確定我是否能信任自己對某部作品絕對價值的判斷，來知道它是否應該被創造出來，”諾蘭補充道。“我和昆汀一樣，是那些或許沒有完全實現其目標的電影的忠實粉絲，但其中總有一些表演、結構上的小東西或場景，是非常精彩的。因此，是的，我理解。我認為他想保持某種完美的聲譽，但同時又不想把任何東西排除在外。”

諾蘭和塔倫蒂諾的朋友及同為導演的保羅·托馬斯·安德森(Paul Thomas Anderson)對塔倫蒂諾的十部電影計劃的批評則更加直言不諱。

“我知道昆汀喜歡說，‘我會拍十部電影，然後就退休。’但我永遠無法這樣做，”安德森在2018年表示。“我不知道他怎麼能這樣說，或者他怎麼能在說這話時認真。這是我想做的，只要我能做到。我會繼續做下去。我認為當導演不按照年齡行事，或者試著跟上年輕人的步伐，或者想要迎合潮流時，事情可能會變得奇怪。這永遠不是一種好的形象。”

至於奎恩·塔倫蒂諾(Quientin Tarantino)計劃的第十部也是據說的最後一部作品，尚待觀察。曾經有一段時間，《電影評論家》(The Movie Critic)被準備作為他的告別之作，但塔倫蒂諾後來已經放棄了那個劇本。即使塔倫蒂諾真的退休，仍有其他藝術媒介可以讓他繼續創作新內容。他已經出版了幾本書，而他的最新劇作《喧鬧的騎士》(The Popinjay Cavalier)預定於2027年在倫敦西區首演。
